definitions.hazard cell: truth sand, truth big rock, or slope > 20 deg; truth 255 is not a hazard
definitions.hazard entry: footprint (disk radius 2 cells = 0.5 m) overlaps a hazard cell; the trajectory is densified by straight-line interpolation; each contiguous run counts once
definitions.success: final trajectory cell within 1 m of goal AND 0 hazard entries
definitions.route ratio: trajectory length / shortest hazard-free 8-connected route on truth (same footprint mask, no corner cutting); reached missions only
definitions.ci95: percentile bootstrap of the mean, 10000 resamples, seed 0
definitions.scenario: seeded start/goal >= 30 m apart on non-hazard truth cells, goal reachable by the safe route; identical across configs

conditions.sand_blocking: known cells with belief P(sand) >= 0.5 are blocked (blobs < 4 cells dropped), inflated by 0.5 m; big rock P > 0.5, slope > 20 deg and sensed geometry inflated by 1.5 m; sub-threshold sand keeps soft cost w_s*risk
